article.title: How popular is Donald Trump?
article.subtitle: Silver Bulletin approval ratings for President Trump — and all presidents since Truman.

extraction.summary: Landing page for the Silver Bulletin presidential approval average as of Nov. 4, 2026: Trump at 38.3 percent approval and about 59 percent disapproval, after an all-time low of 36.3; 21 percent strongly approve and nearly 49 strongly disapprove. It describes the version preference for approval (adults, then RV, then LV, the opposite of the generic ballot), influence scores, house-effect adjusted results, issue-specific approval averages, prorating of strong versus somewhat approval, separate RV/LV-only and adults-only averages, and retrospective daily approval averages for every president since Truman as a download.

findings.statement: For the presidential approval average, when a pollster releases multiple versions, Silver Bulletin prefers the all-adult version, then registered voters, then likely voters, because all Americans have a say in how popular the president is. This is the opposite of the generic ballot preference.
findings.rationale: Approval measures the whole public, not just voters.
findings.evidence_quote: If a pollster releases multiple versions of the same survey, we use the all-adult version of the poll before the registered voter version.

findings.statement: Silver Bulletin also publishes approval averages restricted to RV/LV polls, a better gauge for midterm performance, and to all-adult polls, plus strong versus somewhat approval. For pollsters that do not ask intensity, the strong/somewhat split is prorated so it lines up with the topline.
findings.evidence_quote: a handful of pollsters don’t ask about strong versus soft approval, so we prorate the averages

findings.statement: As of Nov. 4, 2026 Trump's approval was 38.3 percent and disapproval about 59 percent, after an all-time low of 36.3 percent; 21 percent strongly approved and nearly 49 percent strongly disapproved.
findings.evidence_quote: Donald Trump’s approval rating recently hit an all time low of 36.3 percent.

findings.statement: Final approval-average influence scores included AtlasIntel (3,566 adults) 1.75, TIPP (1,158 LV) 1.20, Zogby (1,001 LV) 1.02, NBC/Hart (1,000 RV) 0.99, FT/Focaldata (2,444 adults) 0.94, Reuters/Ipsos (1,765 adults) 0.78, Emerson 0.77, YouGov (3,915 LV) 0.67, Harvard-Harris 0.66, Rasmussen (1,500 LV) 0.62. The weight for daily tracking polls is adjusted so interviews are not double-counted.
Silver Bulletin tracks issue-specific approval averages on the economy, immigration, trade and tariffs, and inflation or cost of living, using the same methodology.
findings.evidence_quote: We’re tracking how the public feels about Trump’s handling of four topics: the economy, immigration, trade and tariffs, and the cost of living.

findings.statement: Silver Bulletin provides retrospectively calculated daily approval averages for every president since 1945 (Truman onward) as a downloadable 'Historical Approval Averages' XLSX, plus a download of every Trump approval poll in its database.
findings.evidence_quote: Note that these are calculated retrospectively; Substack wasn’t around during the Eisenhower administration.
